principles.intent_title: Drift is caught while the work happens
requirements: Drift on linked code is resolved in the turn that makes it
Records that may silently depend on a changed record are shown as hints
A change no requirement owns gets a judge-proposed owner and is held at merge
A commit is warned, never held, when the judge says its diff does not serve the requirement it claims

principles.intent_title: The agent with plumb is the owner's interface
requirements: The owner reaches every plumb capability in plain words, never an id or a shell command
plumb explain answers in plain words about a feature, a behaviour or a file
Everything the owner reads speaks at the owner's level
The Obsidian view is generated and never approves

principles.intent_title: Approximate words are formalized, and a validated interpretation counts
requirements: An approval pins the exact content approved; any later edit goes back to the judge
A hidden regression of an approved example holds until the test that passed before passes again
Only words plumb itself saw from the owner count, kept as a pre-intent with their context
A judge-validated interpretation approves on the owner's behalf; there is no approval command
The agent can never write an approval
The owner arbitrates a conflict through a question, with the agent's recommendation first

principles.intent_title: Intent is captured when given, and rationalized into one coherent set
requirements: An owner answer is captured with the question it answered, once, and rationalized into the intent
Each captured piece is rationalized into one coherent intent set
The owner's message is read by meaning; the clear part is taken and only the unclear part asked again
A reversal re-formalizes the record, and counts as a calibration 'no' only when plumb misread the owner

principles.intent_title: Ask only about intent and trade-offs; route what cannot settle to a debug workflow
requirements: An open question lives only while it stands
plumb resolves from the recorded intent what it already answers before asking
An open question the approved records already answer, or that duplicates another, is withdrawn in the background
A principle is asked once and settles the questions that hinge on it
What plumb cannot settle goes to a debug workflow, the owner last
The debug workflow asks the owner only what it cannot find, once, in plain words

principles.intent_title: Clarification on command, every blocking question through the question tool
requirements: /plumb intent opens one intent loop whose stages each run only on the previous stage's passed gate
The clarifier reads the owner's words in context and asks every blocking question, specific, through the question tool
The clarifier's false-gap rate is measured on an evaluation set before calibration
Outside the loop the edit gate closes only when a request or edit would contradict or extend a confirmed record
The edit gate cannot be switched off by accident
A big request's records are approved as one set, in one step
A big request gets the intent loop suggested once, in one line
A big request's set is repaired by the agent until it is clean

principles.intent_title: Few records, one durable behaviour each, never lost
requirements: A record is a Markdown file named by its id, hashed by its meaning
A link pins both ends and changes only through logged commands
The log is append-only, one hash-chained file per entry
A replaced record is retired with its trail, and its tests follow
A requirement is one durable behaviour, and a fix goes under its requirement
Capture turns the owner's words into linked records in one call
A decision keeps its alternatives and changes only by a superseding decision
A capture names the requirements its new intent changes or contradicts
The pi-agent-factory import is read-only, idempotent and never manufactures approval

principles.intent_title: An independent judge, and a hold when none is reachable
requirements: An independent judge checks every new or changed record against the owner's whole words
The judge's premise is found wherever the owner's words were logged
A judgment made on the quote alone is marked so, never fast-tracks, and is counted at calibration
Verdicts come from one cascade, JEV first, else the judge model, following judge_model
JEV's provider and credential name are settings; the key never enters the repository
JEV's question form is a setting, and a calibration counts only for the form it measured
With no judge reachable, plumb says so once and holds only what needs a verdict
Code is judged against its requirements edge by edge, weakest first, advisory
The merge check lists touched requirements unjudged or drifting, without changing its exit code

principles.intent_title: The fast track: JEV above 0.9, else Sonnet asks, then JEV again
requirements: A record is approved by the judge cascade: JEV above 0.9 fast-tracks it, else the judge model asks through the question tool and JEV judges again
An older record's words are looked for in the owner's own past messages, and finding them approves nothing
Only the owner switches the fast track, and a JEV version change suspends it
Every judge approval is marked with its judge and counted; an entry under the cascade's bar is inert
JEV is calibrated on the owner's own answers before it may fast-track

principles.intent_title: Done means shown working the way the owner chose
requirements: Every requirement carries the proof the owner chose, and done and the merge refuse without its evidence
A merge is never green while an affected acceptance test lacks a passing run on the current identity
Each turn's changes are verified by targeted covering tests, not the full suite

principles.intent_title: Parallel work by awareness; the merge is the one hold
requirements: Record files merge field by field, and a same-field clash becomes one intent conflict
Record ids never collide across worktrees and clones
Intent in flight is shared, and a contradicting capture is caught before any build
A capture that contradicts another branch's claim is put to the owner before anything is built
The merge is the one hold on unapproved or conflicting intent
A commit names the requirements it serves in a trailer, checked at commit
plumb's git hooks are installed on adoption and leave hooks plumb did not write alone
The owner's status shows where intent stands, in one line
plumb's band connects at session start, or says once why it is off
The end of a turn carries at most one plumb line
The agent gets everything as text
A question to the owner stands alone and holds what is needed to choose

A study-room answer applies to exactly what was shown and reaches its session's agent once
The study room draws a question's diagram safely above it
A question about structure or flow comes with a diagram
Long plumb work shows its step and progress

principles.intent_title: plumb runs in the background with generous limits and visible progress
requirements: plumb's model work runs as batched background jobs
Background processes open no window and outlive the hook that started them

The post-edit hook records each edited path for the turn

retired_decisions.why: In no cluster but listed under P1: a one-time clean-up of links left stale from before the drift gate; the v2 record set is pinned fresh when it lands, so no pre-gate stale link remains to rule on.
the names of plumb's shell commands (validate, tests map, hooks install, statusline) are internal under P2: the owner never types them, so their naming is no longer the owner's decision
plumb relay no longer exists and there is no approval command (P3): no command records an approval the agent relays
it routes the 'Ask for a change' card button into the message box; cards and their buttons are retired (P12), and a change is said in conversation or in the question tool, read by meaning
'Leave open' is a card button; P12 retires cards as a thing the owner reads and presses, and an unanswered question-tool question is simply dismissed, capturing nothing (P4)

P3 removes owner reconfirmation of edits: an edit is validated by the judge and the owner is asked only to arbitrate a change of older intent; its surviving rule (asked once per principle with the derived records named, never one question per record) is carried by 'A principle is asked once and settles the questions that hinge on it'
it sizes a one-line offer the owner confirms with 'ok' and the agent relays (plumb relay --group); the owner approves nothing by reading, the judge cascade approves a set in one step (P2, P3, P9)
overturned by its own alternative: the log is one file per entry under .plumb/log/<kind>/ (INT-022, the append-only log requirement), not two JSONL streams
superseded by the full importer: a requirement whose upstream human consent pins its current content is approved by import (the import requirement); everything else stays proposed
matters false and an implementation choice; its rule (links live in their source record) is stated by the link requirement
Chose a line on the read-back card for the judge's doubts; read-back cards are retired (P3, P12) and doubts reach the owner only as question-tool questions (P9).
Low stakes (matters false); Sonnet as an option is now just a value of judge_model, folded into the cascade decision.
Low stakes (matters false); keeping JEV's choice output as a configuration is carried by the jev.output setting in the JEV settings requirement.
trial cards are read-back cards the owner reads and presses, retired by P3 and P12; calibration labels come from the owner's question-tool answers and reversals instead
settling switching itself on once calibrated contradicts P9 as confirmed: only the owner switches the fast track, and settling by context is removed (DEC-040)
working the backlog as one card per feature rests on the retired cards (P12) and the SR-107 trial one-off; the v2 records land fresh and go through the judge cascade

matters false and an implementation choice; it named one .plumb/log/evidence.jsonl stream, overtaken by the one-file-per-entry log (P7) and P15's compaction; that evidence is pinned and committed is stated by the targeted verification requirement
matters false; its rule (an existing test that passed and now fails is a regression even if its source changed, only a new red test exempt) is stated by the merge requirement and its examples
a branch-version conflict on SR-184 whose two quoted versions are word-for-word the same; version 2 supersedes SR-184, so the question no longer stands (P5)
a branch-version conflict on SR-182, which version 2 supersedes with the P9 cascade, so the question no longer stands (P5)
a one-time choice about landing the done work under the old record set, not a durable rule; version 2 lands on the owner's word, and afterwards the merge stays the one hold under P11
'No' as a card button: cards and their buttons are retired (P12); the owner answers through the question tool or the study room
the terminal card that called the diagram mod's renderer is retired (P12); the study room draws the diagram's SVG itself
matters false; its rule (a session brief of about 30 lines, cap 40) is stated by the context requirement

matters false and an implementation choice; its rule (the plugin carries a ready-built plumb checked against the source and sets up a private copy per user and plugin version, called through one launcher) is stated by the plugin requirement
